BiblicalUsage: Reelaiah is named among the men who came up from the captivity with Zerubbabel, Jeshua and Nehemiah to rebuild Jerusalem. He appears once, in the list of the returning exiles.
TheologicalSignificance: What strikes me is that the return from exile is told in names like his, ordinary men who came home to rebuild.
